steps.name: l0-hub-1-wav-kit
steps.verify: set -o pipefail && make check-sandbox 2>&1 | tee /tmp/l0-hub-1.log | tail -25 && grep -q 'check-sandbox: green' /tmp/l0-hub-1.log && (cd tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest && node headless-wav.test.js) 2>&1 | tee /tmp/l0-wav.log | tail -20 && ! grep -q '^FAIL' /tmp/l0-wav.log && grep -q 'PASS soundWav writes the canonical 44-byte header' /tmp/l0-wav.log && grep -q 'PASS soundWavUrl round-trips through soundFromWav' /tmp/l0-wav.log && grep -q 'PASS soundFromWav refuses what the orb does not play' /tmp/l0-wav.log && grep -q 'PASS the clock fixture carries inline samples' /tmp/l0-wav.log && grep -q 'PASS the pomodoro fixture carries inline samples' /tmp/l0-wav.log && python3 docs/specs/l0-hub-fixtures.py pre && make check-runner check-migrations && python3 tools/check_app_versions.py && python3 tools/rebake_shelf.py --check && grep -qx 'v1.8.1' apps/clock/version.txt && grep -qx 'v1.8.2' apps/pomodoro/version.txt && git diff --exit-code l0 -- 'apps/clock/editor/*.js' 'apps/pomodoro/editor/*.js' apps/clock/editor/editor.json apps/pomodoro/editor/editor.json main tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/studio@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/host@1 'tools/orb-manager/*.go' version.txt && test -z "$(git diff --name-only l0 | grep -v -E '^(tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/baker@1/|tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/|apps/(clock|pomodoro)/editor/_fixtures/|apps/(clock|pomodoro)/version.txt|tools/orb-manager/apps/|tools/orb-manager/themes/|docs/)')"

steps.name: l0-hub-2-clock
steps.verify: set -o pipefail && make check-sandbox 2>&1 | tee /tmp/l0-hub-2.log | tail -25 && grep -q 'check-sandbox: green' /tmp/l0-hub-2.log && (cd apps/clock/editor/_selftest && node headless-test.js) 2>&1 | tee /tmp/l0-clock.log | tail -30 && grep -q 'suites green' /tmp/l0-clock.log && (cd apps/clock/editor/_selftest && node headless-l0-sound.test.js) > /tmp/l0-clock-checks.log 2>&1 && ! grep -q '^FAIL' /tmp/l0-clock-checks.log && for c in 'the clock reads design schema 2' 'a pre-L0 design opens with its sound' 'its next save stores a file' 'the migration step is pure' 'a legacy pcm in a schema-2 file still reads' 'an unreadable sound keeps its name' 'a 20.1 s upload is refused with its length' 'the bake does not change'; do grep -q "PASS $c" /tmp/l0-clock-checks.log || { echo "missing PASS $c"; exit 1; }; done && python3 docs/specs/l0-hub-fixtures.py pre && python3 docs/specs/l0-hub-fixtures.py clock && grep -q '"schema": 2' apps/clock/editor/editor.json && grep -q 'DESIGN_SCHEMA = 2' apps/clock/editor/clock-logic.js && make check-runner check-migrations && python3 tools/check_app_versions.py && python3 tools/rebake_shelf.py --check && git diff --exit-code delegate/l0-hub-1-wav-kit -- apps/pomodoro tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/studio@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/baker@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/host@1 'tools/orb-manager/*.go' main version.txt apps/clock/editor/_fixtures/schema-1.orbdesign && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/l0-hub-1-wav-kit | grep -v -E '^(apps/clock/|tools/orb-manager/apps/|tools/orb-manager/themes/|docs/)')"

steps.name: l0-hub-3-pomodoro
steps.verify: set -o pipefail && make check-sandbox 2>&1 | tee /tmp/l0-hub-3.log | tail -25 && grep -q 'check-sandbox: green' /tmp/l0-hub-3.log && (cd tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest && node headless-pomodoro-sound.test.js) 2>&1 | tee /tmp/l0-pomo.log | tail -20 && ! grep -q '^FAIL' /tmp/l0-pomo.log && for c in 'the pomodoro reads design schema 2' 'a pre-L0 design opens with its sound' 'its next save stores a file' 'the migration step is pure' 'a legacy pcm still reads' 'an unreadable sound keeps its name' 'the bake does not change'; do grep -q "PASS $c" /tmp/l0-pomo.log || { echo "missing PASS $c"; exit 1; }; done && python3 docs/specs/l0-hub-fixtures.py pre && python3 docs/specs/l0-hub-fixtures.py clock && python3 docs/specs/l0-hub-fixtures.py pomodoro && grep -q '"schema": 2' apps/pomodoro/editor/editor.json && make check-runner check-migrations check-web check-editor-origin && python3 tools/check_app_versions.py && python3 tools/rebake_shelf.py --check && git diff --exit-code delegate/l0-hub-2-clock -- apps/clock tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/studio@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/baker@1 tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/host@1 'tools/orb-manager/*.go' main version.txt apps/pomodoro/editor/_fixtures/schema-1.orbdesign && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/l0-hub-2-clock | grep -v -E '^(apps/pomodoro/|tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/|tools/orb-manager/apps/|tools/orb-manager/themes/|docs/)')"
